# API and UI regression

A tester protects an API/UI behavior matrix before and after a fix. Run each supplied case and retain both expected and actual outputs.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
[
  {
    "id": "other-object",
    "expected": 403,
    "actual": 200,
    "passed": false
  },
  {
    "id": "input-retained",
    "expected": "same-input",
    "actual": "cleared",
    "passed": false
  },
  {
    "id": "normal-submit",
    "expected": 201,
    "actual": 201,
    "passed": true
  }
]
```

## Failure prevented
A blanket passed label conceals a failing case in the broken version.

## Decision and limits
Accept only the specified result set. Escalate a missing identity, permission, business probe or required not-run item. This is an original synthetic teaching reference, not evidence of learner execution or real employment.
